title: Getting Started with penguinExplorer
text: penguinExplorer package provides interactive Shiny app exploring penguin body measurements. app designed biology students beginners want investigate following question: penguin body measurements differ across species islands?

title: Getting Started with penguinExplorer
text: package contains cleaned version Palmer Penguins dataset. original data contains 344 observations. removing observations missing body mass, flipper length bill length, cleaned dataset contains 342 observations six variables. three penguin species Adelie, Chinstrap Gentoo. observations come Biscoe, Dream Torgersen islands. Source: https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/

title: Penguin Species Explorer
text: app designed biology students beginners interested exploring differences penguin body measurements. main question : penguin body measurements differ across species islands? Users can select penguin species, islands, body measurements explore patterns scatter plot, summary table, dynamic findings.

title: Penguin Species Explorer
text: package uses data palmerpenguins R package. original dataset contains 344 penguins three species: Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo. cleaned dataset contains 342 observations six variables. Observations missing body mass, flipper length, bill length removed. Data source: https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/ original dataset available CC0 licence.
